Info

Compiles vertical approach and retract motion DSL instructions (APPROACH, RETRACT) into waypoints.

class scaralang.core.service.compiler.motion.vertical.vertical_move_compiler.VerticalMoveCompiler[source]¶

Bases: object

Sub-compiler handling vertical motion instructions (APPROACH, RETRACT).

It defines:

attributes:
_SUPPORTED - Frozenset of handled ScaraCommandType instances.
methods:
__init__ - Initializes vertical move compiler.
can_compile - Checks if command is an APPROACH or RETRACT instruction.
compile - Adjusts height coordinates and appends vertical motion waypoints.
_SUPPORTED: frozenset[ScaraCommandType] = frozenset({ScaraCommandType.APPROACH, ScaraCommandType.RETRACT})¶
can_compile(*, instruction: ScaraInstruction) → bool[source]¶

Determines whether this sub-compiler handles the specified instruction.

Parameters:

instruction – Primitive AST instruction node.

Returns:

True if handled, False otherwise.

Exceptions:

None.

compile(*, instruction: ScaraInstruction, context: ScaraCompilerContext) → tuple[Waypoint, ...][source]¶

Processes APPROACH and RETRACT instructions and returns computed waypoints.

Parameters:

  • instruction – Primitive AST instruction node.

  • context – Mutable compiler execution context.

Returns:

Tuple containing compiled Waypoint instance.

Exceptions:

None.
